name: Total-Text: Arbitrary-Shaped Curved Scene Text Dataset
description: A comprehensive benchmark designed to push text detection beyond traditional horizontal and multi-oriented rectangular assumptions toward arbitrary shapes and curved textlines. Curated by the University of Malaya. Comprises 1,555 natural images containing 11,459 text instances categorized into horizontal, multi-oriented, and curved orientations. Each instance is delineated with word-level polygonal annotations (up to 10 vertices) and corresponding character transcriptions.
